semantics: Raw dispatches supplied count bytes. CString scans readable non-null source before dispatch and excludes its terminator, including the zero-return release CRT branch. Empty strings still execute Win32 WriteFile with zero count.

U32 alternate duplicates original U32 body. U16 truncates then encodes two bytes; U8 encodes the low byte without reading endian flag. Widths two/four reload global91eea0 each call and reverse for any nonzero value.

Raw F32 entry executes original FLD/FSTP. Finite values, infinities and quiet NaNs preserve tested bits. Signaling NaNs are excluded because NativeX86/Unicorn does not model hardware x87 quieting; portable SingleBits rejects them. CPU/FPU status and by-value caller stack argument mutations are outside logical file projection.
